The Menu

A Seated Dinner

A 3 to 4 course menu, selected below and served in your home by our chef and floor team. Add the pasta course between starter and main for a four-course dinner.

Hourly rates are billed per team member for time on site. Staff hours typically include about 2 hours before service for setup and 1 hour after for cleanup, so a dinner from 7pm to 10pm comes to roughly 6 hours on site. Team size and hours are scaled to your guest count and service style.
